question: What is the name of the new antibiotic developed to combat AMR (Antimicrobial Resistance) in India in December 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nafithromycin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nafithromycin** is a novel antibiotic developed to tackle the growing challenge of **Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)**.
 
• AMR occurs when bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites evolve resistance to medications, rendering traditional antibiotics ineffective.
 
• This antibiotic is considered a breakthrough in the fight against AMR, especially in India, where the burden of drug-resistant infections is significant.
 
• Developed in December **2024**, Nafithromycin is specifically designed to combat respiratory and other bacterial infections that no longer respond to conventional antibiotics.
 
• It is categorized as a **macrolide antibiotic**, a class of drugs known for inhibiting bacterial protein synthesis.
